question.text: How do changes in RFIC validation technology affect the measurement capability required from Oscilloscope?

exchange.sent: How do changes in RFIC validation technology affect the measurement capability required from Oscilloscope?

answer.answer:
### 可確認的影響
| RFIC validation 變化 | 對量測能力的影響 | 對 Oscilloscope 的可支持說法 |
|---|---|---|
| RFIC 範圍包含 array、RF + Baseband、devices、reference designs。[98] | RFIC validation 可能涉及 array 與 RF/Baseband 相關量測對象。[98] | 來源未直接把這些 RFIC 對象連到 Oscilloscope 量測項目。[98] |
### 與 Oscilloscope 相關的已知量測能力
| Oscilloscope 相關證據 | 支持的能力 |
|---|---|
| O-RAN beamforming DL concept 使用 R&S RTO、R&S OSP、R&S VSE software 與多個 antenna ports。[53] | Oscilloscope 在該量測概念中參與多 antenna-port beamforming measurement。[53] |
| DL concept 描述 parallel-sequential measurement：measure 2 ports simultaneously、固定 reference port、重複直到所有 port relations / weights 被決定。[53] | Oscilloscope 相關 setup 至少涉及同時量測 2 ports 與 port relation/weights 的取得流程。[53] |
| Beamforming measurement task 包含量測 ports 間 amplitude and phase / time relation，並計算 beam direction / beam weights。[19] | 相關量測能力重點是 antenna ports 間 amplitude、phase/time relation 與 beam weights / direction。[19] |
### 推論
【推論】若 RFIC validation 對象包含 array，且 validation 需要類似 beamforming ports 關係量測，Oscilloscope setup 會更需要同時量測至少 2 ports 並取得 amplitude、phase/time relation；但來源沒有直接把 RFIC array validation 與 R&S RTO 連成同一個測試流程。[98][19][53]

來源：
[19] Wiki：O-RAN Beamforming Measurements（來源：`DMRS.md`、`R&S portfolio for O-RU testing.md`）
[53] Wiki：O-RAN Beamforming Measurements（來源：`DMRS.md`、`R&S portfolio for O-RU testing.md`）
[98] `raw/Market/OneNote/TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02.md`

O-RAN Beamforming Measurements › 測量任務
依 Slide 41–42：

- 測試設備 must provide at least 2 connectors to DUT。
- Sequential measurement is allowed。
- Test frame is repeated with identical settings until TER synch, demod & extract beam weights。
- TER must extract or calculate weights, magnitude / phase relation or beam direction。
- For UL measurements, repeat and apply different beam weights。
- Best performance（EVM, power, SNR）is expected only with the correct beam weights。
- Measurement task 包含：
  - Calibrate antenna element RF ports for valid beamforming capabilities。
  - Measure amplitude and phase / time relation between ports。
  - Calculate resulting beam direction / beam weights。
- O-RAN Conformance Test Specification chapter 3.2.3.2ff 涉及 analog beamforming（TD）and/or digital beamforming（FD）。
- One beam per section at a time。
- At least two antenna ports must be measured。
- Simultaneous and sequential testing are possible。

R&S CMX500 › NR FR1
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM600 是 frequency range 1 對 NR uplink signals 執行任何 TX tests 的必要 option。NR FR1 uplink measurements 包含 multi-evaluation、PRACH、SRS、TPC measurement。Multi-evaluation 支援 NR channel bandwidth **3 MHz 到 100 MHz**，可分析 FDD 與 TDD signals、NR standalone signals 與 intraband contiguous EN-DC signals。

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，R&S CMX-KM600 option 的 5G NR analyzer 條件為 FR1、SCS 30 kHz、16QAM、temperature range +15 °C to +35 °C；input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。Frequency measurement uncertainty：**< 20 Hz + drift of timebase**；相對於同一台 CMX500 device 的 downlink signal 進行 frequency error measurements 時，uncertainty 符合 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] V18.5.0。

R&S CMX-KW601 option 的 5G NR generator 條件：5G NR PDSCH、full allocation、SCS 30 kHz / 60 kHz、modulation 64QAM、PAR 11.8 dB、temperature +15 °C to +35 °C；ports RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF Out 1 to RF Out 4；output level –5 dBm、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。

|---|---|

| DL concept 描述 parallel-sequential measurement：measure 2 ports simultaneously、固定 reference port、重複直到所有 port relations / weights 被決定。[53] | Oscilloscope 相關 setup 至少涉及同時量測 2 ports 與 port relation/weights 的取得流程。[53] |

【推論】若 RFIC validation 對象包含 array，且 validation 需要類似 beamforming ports 關係量測，Oscilloscope setup 會更需要同時量測至少 2 ports 並取得 amplitude、phase/time relation；但來源沒有直接把 RFIC array validation 與 R&S RTO 連成同一個測試流程。[98][19][53]

O-RAN Beamforming Measurements › 測量任務
依 Slide 41–42：

- 測試設備 must provide at least 2 connectors to DUT。
- Sequential measurement is allowed。
- Test frame is repeated with identical settings until TER synch, demod & extract beam weights。
- TER must extract or calculate weights, magnitude / phase relation or beam direction。
- For UL measurements, repeat and apply different beam weights。
- Best performance（EVM, power, SNR）is expected only with the correct beam weights。
- Measurement task 包含：
  - Calibrate antenna element RF ports for valid beamforming capabilities。
  - Measure amplitude and phase / time relation between ports。
  - Calculate resulting beam direction / beam weights。
- O-RAN Conformance Test Specification chapter 3.2.3.2ff 涉及 analog beamforming（TD）and/or digital beamforming（FD）。
- One beam per section at a time。
- At least two antenna ports must be measured。
- Simultaneous and sequential testing are possible。

O-RAN Beamforming Measurements › DL concept
依 Slide 43：

- General Concept – BFM Measurement DL 使用 [[R&S RTO]]、[[R&S OSP]]、[[R&S VSE]] software 與多個 antenna ports。
- 來源描述 parallel-sequential measurement：
  - Measure 2 ports simultaneously。
  - Use a fixed reference port for all measurements。
  - Repeat until all port relations are determined。
  - Capture port combinations until all weights are determined，preferably relative to a single reference port。
- OSP calibrated in advance。

O-RAN Beamforming Measurements › 測量任務
依 Slide 41–42：

- 測試設備 must provide at least 2 connectors to DUT。
- Sequential measurement is allowed。
- Test frame is repeated with identical settings until TER synch, demod & extract beam weights。
- TER must extract or calculate weights, magnitude / phase relation or beam direction。
- For UL measurements, repeat and apply different beam weights。
- Best performance（EVM, power, SNR）is expected only with the correct beam weights。
- Measurement task 包含：
  - Calibrate antenna element RF ports for valid beamforming capabilities。
  - Measure amplitude and phase / time relation between ports。
  - Calculate resulting beam direction / beam weights。
- O-RAN Conformance Test Specification chapter 3.2.3.2ff 涉及 analog beamforming（TD）and/or digital beamforming（FD）。
- One beam per section at a time。
- At least two antenna ports must be measured。
- Simultaneous and sequential testing are possible。

### 與 Oscilloscope 相關的已知量測能力
| Oscilloscope 相關證據 | 支持的能力 |
|---|---|
| O-RAN beamforming DL concept 使用 R&S RTO、R&S OSP、R&S VSE software 與多個 antenna ports。[53] | Oscilloscope 在該量測概念中參與多 antenna-port beamforming measurement。[53] |
| DL concept 描述 parallel-sequential measurement：measure 2 ports simultaneously、固定 reference port、重複直到所有 port relations / weights 被決定。[53] | Oscilloscope 相關 setup 至少涉及同時量測 2 ports 與 port relation/weights 的取得流程。[53] |

O-RAN Beamforming Measurements › 測量任務
依 Slide 41–42：

- 測試設備 must provide at least 2 connectors to DUT。
- Sequential measurement is allowed。
- Test frame is repeated with identical settings until TER synch, demod & extract beam weights。
- TER must extract or calculate weights, magnitude / phase relation or beam direction。
- For UL measurements, repeat and apply different beam weights。
- Best performance（EVM, power, SNR）is expected only with the correct beam weights。
- Measurement task 包含：
  - Calibrate antenna element RF ports for valid beamforming capabilities。
  - Measure amplitude and phase / time relation between ports。
  - Calculate resulting beam direction / beam weights。
- O-RAN Conformance Test Specification chapter 3.2.3.2ff 涉及 analog beamforming（TD）and/or digital beamforming（FD）。
- One beam per section at a time。
- At least two antenna ports must be measured。
- Simultaneous and sequential testing are possible。

O-RAN Beamforming Measurements › DL concept
依 Slide 43：

- General Concept – BFM Measurement DL 使用 [[R&S RTO]]、[[R&S OSP]]、[[R&S VSE]] software 與多個 antenna ports。
- 來源描述 parallel-sequential measurement：
  - Measure 2 ports simultaneously。
  - Use a fixed reference port for all measurements。
  - Repeat until all port relations are determined。
  - Capture port combinations until all weights are determined，preferably relative to a single reference port。
- OSP calibrated in advance。
